result_summary.title: Analytics Dashboard showing missing and mismatched records
result_summary.description: We are seeing significant data discrepancies in the Analytics Dashboard in staging. Records that should be present are missing, and the values shown don't match our source data. This affects over 400 users. We are fairly certain this is due to a configuration error on our side where we mapped the wrong fields during the last update, so please verify if our config is the root cause.
